scientific_question: Does a low-rank objective-gradient covariance degree of freedom materially improve absolute FreeOracle budget efficiency?

S0.label: scalar_isotropic_baseline
S0.freeoracle_rule: reuse the frozen per-state M3-BV2 oracle action and frozen 500k arm probability; evaluation replay must be bit-identical

S1.label: rank1_objective_gradient
S1.freeoracle_rule: choose one candidate per state by minimum median replicate estimator variance; exact ties choose base

S2.label: rank2_objective_gradient
S2.freeoracle_rule: choose one candidate per state by minimum median replicate estimator variance; exact ties choose base

gradient_construction.controlled_component: frozen M1-D selected newborn component only

update.normalize: rank-truncated matrix divided by Frobenius norm; zero norm yields base
update.unsafe_update_action: INVALID; family falls back to base and PF1-D is triggered

confirmation.common_random_numbers: same full-grid state index and replicate streams as frozen M3-BV2; every arm receives the same component and standard-normal blocks

primary_endpoint.name: median_state_FreeOracle_VRF_budget
primary_endpoint.formula: median over 24 states of median over 8 replicates of [p_ref(1-p_ref)/100000] / [(M2_selected-P_selected^2)/100000]
primary_endpoint.best_structured_family: max of the separately reported S1 and S2 medians; no rank pooling within states

verdicts.PF1-D: scalar reproduction, protocol, numerical safety, source lock or accounting invalid
